meta.title: Standard Tower Series
meta.description: TZJ standard tower series — high-rise, integrated, and Level 1–5 alarm preset tower types aligned with NFPA 1400/1402 live-fire training standards for fast selection and deep customization.

hero.title: Standard Tower Series
hero.description: Choose from 15 preset layouts to accelerate your project — or start from any layout and customize easily.

complianceSection.title: Aligned with international live-fire training standards
complianceSection.description: Every training structure and burn room option meets live-fire training facility requirements. We tailor base design, fixtures, and props to maximize the training experience for any department size.

durabilitySection.title: Why TZJ fixed towers last longer
durabilitySection.description: Live-fire training means heat, impact, and decades of repeated use. From structure to connections to protection — every element is designed for long-term demanding service.
durabilitySection.note: Compared to concrete/masonry, metal training towers perform more consistently through repeated thermal cycles, typically cost significantly less to build and maintain, and damaged components can be replaced locally without scrapping the whole structure.

durability.title: High-strength wall cladding
durability.desc: Structured steel cladding with rigid treatment withstands repeated ladder climbs, rappelling, and physical impact — far beyond thin panels with self-tapping screws.

durability.title: Bolted rigid connections
durability.desc: Cladding bolted at close spacing into a monolithic load-bearing shell that lasts.

durability.title: Sealed against weather
durability.desc: Every seam sealed against wind, rain, and leakage — supporting all-weather, year-round training.

durability.title: Hot-dip galvanized longevity
durability.desc: Hot-dip galvanized steel resists corrosion with low maintenance; damaged panels are replaceable for long-term reliability.

series.name: High-Rise Series
series.desc: High-rise tower with elevator shaft and stair tower simulating high-rise firefighting; includes two-story residential unit and single-story annex.

series.name: 5th Alarm Series
series.desc: Main tower with interior stairwell; two-story unit with loft and pitched roof; dual breach points and dual burn rooms.

series.name: 3rd Alarm Series
series.desc: Main tower with residential and annex structures; dual live-fire burn rooms for multi-scenario training.

series.name: 1st Alarm Series
series.desc: Interior stairs, climbing ladder, and live-fire burn room meeting baseline live-fire training requirements.

moreSeries.name: Integrated Alarm Series
moreSeries.desc: Main tower + two-story residential/industrial units (with loft); multiple rooms, dual breach points and dual burn rooms.

moreSeries.name: 4th Alarm Series
moreSeries.desc: Multi-level main tower with interior stairwell; two-story unit with pitched roof and loft; dual burn rooms.

moreSeries.name: 2nd Alarm Series
moreSeries.desc: Two-story unit connected to single-story annex — multi-room layout (office) and open space (warehouse) training.

compareSection.title: Standard tower vs. custom tower
compareSection.description: Preset towers get projects live faster; custom towers fit unique requirements exactly. Both get the same rugged steel structure and turnkey service.
